driving.name: driving_summary
driving.not_one_of_the_six: a denominator, not a finding: the six are ratios over what servers did in response to these calls

numbers.distinct_hosts_note: same quantity as number 2; published here so the raw connection count is never read on its own
numbers.launcher_connections_note: seen while the launcher was resolving the package, before the server process existed. Excluded from every per-call figure by construction, never discarded
numbers.name: outbound_connections_per_tool_call

numbers.fraction_of_observed_note: THE FIGURE TO READ. Denominator: servers with at least one flow the proxy actually saw. A server the proxy never saw is not a server that declined to propagate; see the observability block and docs/THREATS.md threat 19
numbers.name: servers_propagating_traceparent

observability.egress_expectation_note: this run did not record which servers the registry expects to egress, so every server that completed a call and produced no flow is counted as unobserved. That over-counts local servers, which egress nothing by design. Re-run to get the distinction; it is not inferred here
observability.warning: 7 server(s) completed calls and produced NO observed flow. Their egress, if any, is invisible to the proxy. Run `make backstop` on this run's pcap: outbound SYNs to a destination that is not the proxy are the evidence that traffic left the machine unobserved. No figure below may treat those servers as having egressed nothing
observability.what_this_measures: how many servers the CAPTURE LAYER could see, which is not how many were driven. A server whose client ignores HTTP(S)_PROXY is driven, answers and egresses while leaving nothing in flows.jsonl, so counting it as a measured zero would state a fact about our instrument as a fact about the server (docs/THREATS.md threat 19)

numbers.pooled_fraction_is_not_comparable: its denominator counts servers whose egress was never observed, so it reports NOT MEASURED as a zero. Kept because withholding it would hide how much of the set was invisible, and never to be quoted on its own
numbers.pooled_note: read the segments; SEP-414 is a 2026-07-28 change, so a server answering an earlier revision predates the convention

numbers.content_denominator_warning: no flow in this run carries the constant-path flag, so the content denominator equals the attributable one. Either the run genuinely contained no constant client chatter, or it was captured before the flag existed. A pre-F2 run reads back False on every flow, which counts every flow IN, and that is the conservative direction rather than the flattering one

discrimination.what_this_measures: per wave size: how many in-flight calls owned no token distinguishing them from their neighbours, and how many times a call was contained in a request and still refused as a candidate. Both are threat 18 made visible in the output

numbers.name: attribution_grade_distribution
numbers.published_as_reason: the sensor's self-match recall on realistic argument material is below 1, so an attributable share measured with it is a floor and not an estimate. Measured by `make inventory`; decomposed per family in docs/CALIBRATION.md, 'The self-match ceiling', and stated as threat 12 in docs/THREATS.md
numbers.raw_fraction_is_not_comparable: strong_attribution_fraction divides by every flow in the run, including package infrastructure and flows seen before any call was sent. It is published so the share of a run that is machinery stays visible, and it may not be compared with either figure below or with another run's
numbers.sequential_driving_note: every flow was seen with at most one call in flight, so CONTENT_UNIQUE is unreachable by construction and content matches grade as CONTENT_MATCH_UNCONTESTED. This is the expected outcome of the sequential pass and is reported as such, never as a finding about content matching. The distribution that answers whether content matching discriminates comes from the concurrent pass; see docs/PHASES.md, phase B

structural_instrument.warning: calls were in flight and NO flow in this run shows the structural matcher considering any of them. Either no request carried argument material at all, or the instrument did not run: a driver that stopped publishing token_digests produces exactly this, and number 5's grades would then come from the k-gram matcher under the structural one's name. Check before reading any figure here as a finding (docs/THE-GATE.md rule 10)

numbers.name: selfhostable_third_parties
numbers.node_set_is_truncated: 7 server(s) completed calls and produced no observed flow, so their destinations are absent from these 4 nodes. This fraction describes the third parties the capture layer could see, not the third parties that were touched. See docs/THREATS.md threat 19
